expr: (() => { const R=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]')]; return R.length===3 && R[0].min==='0' && R[0].max==='1.8' && R[1].min==='2.2' && R[1].max==='4' && R[2].min==='0.2' && R[2].max==='3.8' && R.every(r=>r.step==='0.1') ? 1 : 0 })()

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Alusta' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: reset button first; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
